Kunal

Contact: + 91-8799722885

Business Analyst at Citi Bank with nearly 5 years of experience, deeply passionate about investment research and asset valuation. Proficient in leveraging tools for Analysis and Product Management. Currently pursuing CFA L1 to deepen my expertise.

Educational Qualification

Qualification BBE XII, CBSE

Institute

Shivaji College, University of Delhi St. Martins Diocesan School, Delhi

CGPA/ % 7.80/10 85.00

Year 2021 2018

Work Experience

Citi Bank, Pune Business Analyst/Product Owner, Asset Management

Aug 2023 – June 2026

Conducted end-to-end trade lifecycle data analysis via SQL (ELT) for CSDR fee to identify process gaps, document business requirements, and recommend actionable solutions improving STP rates, driving ~15% efficiency. Translated BRD into functional specifications (FRD) and actionable 25+ user stories for a SaaS based tokenization platform, defining acceptance criteria for QA validation, while maintaining requirements traceability on confluence. • Mapped end-to-end tokenization lifecycle process workflow and swimlane maps in Figma capturing decision nodes system triggers, and exception handling paths accelerating business readiness, supporting UI/UX transformation.



Roles and Responsibilities

Developed Business Scenario Models (BSMs) mapping STP flow, alternate and exception flows, translating 300+ scenarios into structured Test cases, leveraged SWIFT MT540/542..etc messages for trade booking and validated their automated transformation into ISO 20022 (JSON) format across downstream trade lifecycle platforms. • Owned end-to-end UAT execution across 4 different testing cycles, overseeing defect resolution and incident tracking via Jira — achieving 98% defect closure rate within timelines ensuring zero critical defects at go-live. Led cross-functional stakeholder workshops across Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk and Product teams to define system capabilities for a secure digital asset custody platform supporting crypto transactions on blockchain infra using AI tools, drove comprehensive risk mitigation by engineering a 3x3 risk rating matrix with more than 30 attributes.



Key Achievements

Delivered a multi-region tokenization platform (MALT) product development along 4 different product by training a 15-member team on procedure documentation, , ensuring 100% operational readiness and seamless Agile delivery.

Incedo, Gurgaon Investment Banking Analyst, Asset Management

Sep 2021 – Jan 23 • Monitored trade execution and settlement projections to generate liquidity forecasts, ensuring funding optimization. • Partnered with brokers and custodians to resolve multi-million-dollar OTC derivative trade breaks, minimizing risks. • Collaborated with Trade Operations to facilitate the setup of various securities on APL and TNET (Trustnet) platforms using Bloomberg, while providing support to portfolio managers during trade settlements. • Maintained SOP documentation for trade settlement and reconciliation for different Securities & Derivatives. • Generate comprehensive manual pricing reports across Bloomberg, IDC, and other custodian platforms (Fidelity,

Roles and Responsibilities

Pershing) to provide high-fidelity inputs for asset modelling, ensuring accurate daily NAV and robust risk mitigation.

Leadership Experience

University of Delhi (Founding Member & Research Head)

Finance & Investment Cell

Organised 7+ finance and strategy events, engaging 350+ participants across 40+ colleges. •

Led a research vertical for 12 members to deliver weekly sector modules for "Vittlitt" strategic content, analysing the Indian Consumer & Retail landscape for regional prospects

Projects and Internships

Audit Research, (Venture Capital) Live Project

Conducted investment-focused audit analysis on portfolio companies, evaluating cost structures, burn rates, and financial efficiency using Advanced Excel and Python to create expense reports.

Built financial tracking models and derived actionable insights from financial data to support investment decisions and capital allocation, driving ~5% improvement in allocation efficiency.

Analysed company financials, aligning insights with wealth preservation and growth objectives.

I.B Fellowship, Marquee Equity





Evaluated companies across different sectors through in-depth macro investment research, business and market analysis to support capital raising efforts and deal sourcing initiatives with stakeholder management. Facilitated deal sourcing by engaging ~500 companies across sectors, identifying capital-raising opportunities and aligning them with investor mandates and appetite.

2021

Academic Projects

Financial Model of Mahindra & Mahindra

• • •

Performed valuation of Mahindra & Mahindra using DCF and Multiples method for stock recommendation. Forecasted the financial line items based on assumptions from annual report and quarterly conference calls. Financial modelling involved collecting data from SIAM, TMA and industry reports by research agencies. Incorporated different scenarios based on expected industry growth rate for different product lines.

2023
